# Scanix QR

> Scanix QR is an Android application for scanning QR codes and barcodes, with local scan history, link safety checks, and text extraction from images using OCR.

## Official Website

- Homepage: https://scanix-qr.pages.dev/
- About the app: https://scanix-qr.pages.dev/about.html
- Privacy policy: https://scanix-qr.pages.dev/privacy.html
- Download information: https://scanix-qr.pages.dev/download.html
- QR creation feature: https://scanix-qr.pages.dev/qr-creation.html

## About the Application

Scanix QR helps users scan QR codes and barcodes using their Android devices. It includes scan history, options to copy and share results, link safety checks, and OCR-based text extraction.

The application supports Arabic and English. Scanning history is stored locally on the device. Some features, such as checking for updates, require an internet connection.

## Privacy

Consult the official privacy policy for information about the application's data handling and privacy practices.

## Languages

The website and application provide Arabic and English content where available.
